Spectral_Ape_Ghostly_Tendrils.description: Emerging from the mist with a spectral glow, the Spectral Ape's ghostly tendrils stretch and twist with an otherworldly grace, granting it both a fearsome reach and an uncanny ability to detect and manipulate arcane energies.

Chimpanzee_Nimble_Manipulator_Tentacles.description: Emerging from the shadowy depths of the jungle, the Chimpanzee_Nimble_Manipulator_Tentacles is a horrifying yet mesmerizing blend of primate and tentacle, with elongated, dexterous appendages that grant unparalleled reach and agility, enabling it to swing through the dense canopy with preternatural ease and perform feats of sleight of hand that would make even the most cunning thief envious.

Gorilla_Heavy_Slamming_Tentacles.description: Enveloped in a thick layer of chitin-like armor, the Gorilla_Heavy_Slamming_Tentacles are a cluster of robust, muscular appendages that pulsate with raw strength, capable of delivering devastating blows that can shatter bones and tear through armor with ease, complemented by the innate skill to sunder weapons and knock foes off their feet.

Baboon_Muscular_Grasping_Tentacles.description: Emerging from the shadowy recesses of the primordial forest, the Baboon_Muscular_Grasping_Tentacles is a bizarre mutation, its sinewy, prehensile tentacles intertwining with its primate limbs to enhance its strength and agility, allowing it to scale treacherous terrain and ensnare prey with alarming ease.

Spider_Monkey_Long_Whipping_Tentacles.description: Equipped with sinuous, whip-like tentacles that extend far beyond the normal reach of a primate, the Spider_Monkey_Long_Whipping_Tentacles component enhances the agility and dexterity of its host, allowing them to swing and climb with unmatched speed and grace through the densest of canopies.

Mandrill_Colorful_Display_Tentacles.description: The Mandrill's vibrant, iridescent tentacles undulate with otherworldly magic, enhancing its charisma and ability to charm or intimidate, drawing all eyes to their mesmerizing display while granting the primate an aura of enchanting allure and subtle danger.

Lemur_Striped_Sensory_Tentacles.description: The Striped Sensory Tentacles are thin, prehensile appendages that extend from the lemur’s shoulders, enhancing its already keen perception and agility, allowing it to navigate treacherous terrain with unmatched grace and to leap with surprising precision.

Zombie_Ape_Rotting_Tendrils.description: The Zombie_Ape_Rotting_Tendrils, a nightmarish amalgamation of rot and muscle, sprouts gnarled, blackened tentacles from its decaying limbs, each one capable of ensnaring prey with a sickening grip and dripping with a corrosive venom that turns the air toxic.

Tarsier_Rapid_Striking_Tentacles.description: The Tarsier_Rapid_Striking_Tentacles are slender, agile appendages that extend from the primate's body like supple whips, capable of striking with blinding speed and causing deep, bleeding wounds that keep opponents at bay.

Orangutan_Long_Heavy_Tentacles.description: The Orangutan Long Heavy Tentacles are a grotesque mutation, blending the wisdom and strength of a primate with serpentine appendages that grant unparalleled reach and crushing grip, allowing their wielder to swing through treacherous canopies and grapple foes with terrifying efficiency.
